checks: Real supplied GLBs load and render the home scene.
The real Workshop scene has a flat floor and no unsaved indoor appliance geometry.
Workshop lists 40 actual models; room ideas only fill text and real word submission furnishes the chosen room.
A real 3D model can be selected with the pointer, quarter-turned and given a finish.
Blank coordinates and blocked doors reject placement atomically; a real floor click places the valid model preview.
Remove, Undo and Redo change the real layout, and a new edit branches history.
Explicit Save and JSON export roundtrip the house; malformed and overlapping imports preserve it atomically.
Save & explore walks through exactly the saved decor with no combat or letter gain, and return preserves the house.
Reload preserves names, positions, turns and finishes; cross-map import Undo restores that map's saved house independently.
Storage failures and invalid house names report errors without pretending to save.
Wardrobe controls change real modular meshes and persist the selection.
Pause freezes simulation time, health and every AI position.
Keyboard movement advances a live player through the house.
Smash input releases exact tiles; live pickup, recipe UI, craft channel and equipment all connect.
Dropping and picking up gear preserves the physical item.
Round result and next-round controls reset the live arena.
Duos holds E through a real revive channel and restores the buddy to 30 HP.
Moving Day spells and places its final LAMP through UI, shows a win and retries with a fresh checklist.
Moving Out physically carries and drops a keepsake; a downed crew member blocks victory until revived and gathered, then retry resets the rescue.
A native touchscreen joystick gesture moves the player.
Simultaneous native joystick and attack touches are tracked separately.
Mobile HUD has separate touch targets, real item thumbnails and all 12 recipes.
Landscape touch controls, full 18-letter bag and health remain visible, reachable and separate.
Workshop phone portrait and landscape keep primary buttons, house view and scrollable tools separate; native touch places a supplied model.
Native touch joystick explores the peaceful saved house and the return button restores its design.
scope: Real headless Chromium WebGL, keyboard/pointer and touch emulation; not Unity/native hardware execution
snapshot: Immutable pre-rename-fix main; renderer/engine/style unchanged by the subsequent focused UI fix
